prompt: A quiet study desk in a Japanese university at dusk: a neat stack of old science books, an open anatomy atlas of the brain seen at an angle so nothing is readable, a paper desk lamp glowing softly, warm light through a paper screen window. Cinematic still-life photograph at golden hour: low warm sunlight raking across the scene, long soft shadows, amber and honey tones with deep brown shadows, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, calm and premium, like an editorial photo for a science brand. No people, no hands, no faces, no readable text, no logos, no labels, no red.
purpose: Science page look D (Golden hour). An illustration, not a photograph of a real place.
